units.source_text: 内藏助说完这段话，屋里空气由先前的愉快转变成了严肃的气氛。

en.t: After Kuranosuke finished saying this, the mood in the room shifted from its earlier cheerfulness to a solemn atmosphere.

units.source_text: 从这一点上来看，他可以说是按照自己的心思转换了话题。

en.t: Seen from that point of view, he could be said to have changed the subject according to his own wishes.

units.source_text: 但接下来人们的谈话能不能让内藏助感到愉快，就不好说了。

en.t: But whether the conversation that followed would be pleasant for Kuranosuke is hard to say.
